ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 8:1 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels along margins and focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central high-intensity white region bifurcated by notch. Extensive mid-intensity tan/yellowish mottling covers approximately 40% of the surface area, concentrated in the lateral mid-sections of both lobes. Black low-intensity perimeter band. Single circular dark pixel cluster at the proximal-central midline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 70 degrees and sharp vertex depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a pronounced upward concave curve tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity pixel clusters (scars) distributed within the tan regions of both lobes; high-contrast, textured clusters (barnacles) located at the distal lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at distal tips resulting in irregular, high-contrast textured boundaries; distinct dark circular mark at the lower-central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellow/tan biofilm accumulation across the mid-lobe regions creating a distinct bimodal pigmentation pattern against the white base.
